entry.title: ALPHA 1.2.1
entry.summary: ALPHA 1.2.1: bug fix On the gated MIDI modes (Mono-Gated, Poly-Gated) the ATTACK and RELEASE knobs showed on every page, for example in the middle of the User Presets page. They now show only on the MIDI page. Tested on an Akai Force, MPC OS 3.9.1 (2026-11-11). What ALPHA is A granular vocal transformer effect for the Akai Force / MPC OS 3.x. Put it on an input or an insert and sing or play a voice through it. Pitch and formant move separately, with a harmonic shifter, alternator, smear, detune,
